ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, given two lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $O$, $OE$ bisects $\angle BOD$, and $OF$ bisects $\angle COB$. If $\angle BOE = 36^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle DOE + \angle EOB + \angle BOF + \angle FOC = 180^\circ$, and that $OE$ bisects $\angle BOD$ and $OF$ bisects $\angle COB$, \\
thus $2\angle EOB + 2\angle BOF = 180^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle BOE + \angle BOF = 90^\circ$, \\
since $\angle BOE = 36^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle BOF = 90^\circ - 36^\circ = 54^\circ$, \\
given that $\angle AOF + \angle BOF = 180^\circ$, \\
thus $\angle AOF = 180^\circ - 54^\circ = \boxed{126^\circ}$.
